deadlock_stall.interpretation: Per-episode no-progress-over-window stall detector, parameterized and distinct from timeout/max_steps; additive diagnostic, not a benchmark superiority or safety claim.

distributional_disruption.claim_boundary: These metrics are diagnostic simulation measures for analyzing per-subgroup displacement and inconvenience distribution in controlled settings. They do not represent real-world ethical outcomes.

cohort_definitions.extreme_speed_tier: Pedestrians with average control speed > 1.8 m/s
cohort_definitions.fast_speed_tier: Pedestrians with average control speed > 1.0 m/s and <= 1.8 m/s
cohort_definitions.slow_speed_tier: Pedestrians with average control speed <= 1.0 m/s

displacement_mean_m.denominator: matched timesteps per pedestrian, then supported pedestrians per cohort

distributional_disruption.non_claims: We make no claims regarding real-world fairness, equity, bias, protected attributes, demographic groups, or disparate impact. These measures are diagnostic simulation proxies only.
